overviewParagraphs: Nestled in the pristine Binh Tien coastline, Nara Binh Tien Golf Club is a true hidden gem. The Golfplan design team has brilliantly crafted a course that transitions from rugged natural dunes to lush parkland bordered by water, and finally up into the foothills of the Nui Chua mountains. Every hole offers a distinct character and challenge, heavily influenced by the ever-present coastal winds. The pristine Platinum Paspalum grass ensures perfect lies and fast, true-rolling greens. Beyond the course, the expansive clubhouse offers five-star amenities, making it a perfect retreat after a challenging round. Its remote beauty and top-tier design make it an essential stop on any Vietnam golf itinerary.

curatorBriefHtml: Nara Binh Tien Golf Club is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Ninh Thuan, Vietnam, crafted by Kevin Ramsey / David Dale (Golfplan) (2022) and stretching to 6,718 Yards (Blue Tees) across a coastal mountain environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its nui chua national park & ocean backdrop (Breathtaking untouched nature) and platinum te paspalum carpet conditioning (Lush, dense emerald turf).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Nara Binh Tien Golf Club (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie ocean line expertise (Masterful on subtle breaks), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Ninh Thuan golf tour by AGS, Nara Binh Tien Golf Club provides a distinct architectural test by Kevin Ramsey / David Dale (Golfplan) that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

scorecard.verdict: Flanked by the rugged peaks of Nui Chua National Park and the turquoise waters of Binh Tien Beach. One of Vietnam's most visually arresting hidden-gem championship layouts.
